description: Local-first RAG MCP server: hybrid search over a folder of your own documents
name: io.github.sfrangulov/minirag-mcp

environmentVariables.description: One document root; also the security boundary for file access. Defaults to the process working directory. Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of document roots, e.g. ["/docs/a", "/docs/b"]. Takes precedence over BASE_DIR. An invalid value is a hard configuration error.
environmentVariables.name: BASE_DIRS

environmentVariables.description: LanceDB index directory. Defaults to <first root>/.minirag/lancedb, so each corpus gets its own index.
environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model cache. Defaults to the platform user cache dir, so the ~220 MB model is downloaded once and shared.
environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: fastembed model id. Changing it makes existing vectors incompatible with new queries; pair with a new DB_PATH or a full re-ingest.
environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Per-file size limit in bytes, enforced before parsing.
environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE

environmentVariables.description: Retrieval-unit size in the embedding model's own tokens. Range 16-128; the ceiling is the model's trained sequence length.
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET

environmentVariables.description: Keyword weight in the weighted RRF fusion, range 0.0-1.0. 0 is vector-only; higher values raise the BM25 contribution.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT

environmentVariables.description: Result grouping filter. 'similar' keeps only the closest group; 'related' also keeps the next one. Unset means no grouping filter.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Drop results whose vector distance exceeds this value. Lower is stricter. Unset means no distance filter.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Keep chunks from at most this many best-scoring files. Unset means no per-file filter.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Extra paragraph appended to the instructions the server hands the client at connect time, for corpus-specific guidance.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_INSTRUCTIONS_APPEND

environmentVariables.description: Let ingest_url fetch hosts resolving to loopback, link-local, private, reserved or unspecified addresses. Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
